conservative.requirements: 2 power, plus 2 power per target beyond yourself. All targets must be engaged with you. If you have Spellcraft Mastery, you may add 4 recharge tokens to this spell upon casting it successfully. Effect: You use your magic to protect your targets from flame. While this spell is recharging, you and all affected targets who remain engaged with you suffer no damage from non-magical flames. Furthermore, the soak value of all affected targets is increased by 2 against fiery attacks such as a dragon’s fiery breath or most Bright Order spells.
conservative.name: Aqshys Aegis
